reference: N‑Carboxylated‑2‑substituted Indoles and 2,3‑Disubstituted‑2,3‑dihydro‑4‑quinolones from 2‑Alkynylbenzamides — Step A: 2‑(1‑Hexynyl)benzamide
notes: Pd(OAc)₂ (1 mol%), CuI (1 mol%), PPh₃ (2 mol%) in DMF (40 mL) and Et₃N (120 mL); 1‑hexyne (1.3 equiv); 60 °C oil bath under N₂, 16 h; aqueous workup and silica gel chromatography; 90% yield (checkers: 91%).
original_procedure: Step A (paraphrased): In a 500‑mL flask, combine 2‑iodobenzamide (80 mmol), PPh3 (0.02 equiv), CuI (0.01 equiv), Pd(OAc)2 (0.01 equiv), DMF (40 mL), Et3N (120 mL), and 1‑hexyne (1.3 equiv). Purge with N2 and stir at 60 °C for 16 h. Dilute with EtOAc; wash with sat. NH4Cl and brine; dry (Na2SO4), filter, and concentrate. Purify by silica gel chromatography to give 2‑(1‑hexynyl)benzamide (≈90% yield).
